decision: Can January 19, 1993 NSD 79 be selected in a 1989-1992 volume?
recommended_default: Treat as a Bush administration capstone unless the compiler enforces a hard December 31, 1992 terminal date.
evidence_already_assembled: NSD 79 public/control PDF; source-note worklist; selection worksheet.
consequence_of_decision: If yes, NSD 79 can anchor covert-action procedure; if no, keep it as terminal editorial context and prioritize earlier covert-action records.

decision: Does the volume include a separate intelligence matters chapter?
recommended_default: Yes, if primary records support at least PDB process, covert-action/congressional notification, and intelligence budget/community management.
evidence_already_assembled: Intelligence matters chapter; compiler handoff; declassified index.
consequence_of_decision: If yes, reserve document slots for intelligence process records; if no, distribute those records into NSC/process and budget chapters.

decision: Can a PDB process/control record be selected without publishing PDB substance?
recommended_default: Select a primary process/control record if releasable; do not substitute CIA public histories as selected documents.
evidence_already_assembled: Request E1; source-note worklist; intelligence matters chapter.
consequence_of_decision: Determines whether the intelligence chapter has a presidential-consumption document or only an editorial chronology.

decision: How should Presidential Daily Diary and Daily Backup material be used?
recommended_default: Use for chronology, participants, call status, and backup-material existence only; pair with substantive records.
evidence_already_assembled: Request E2; source-note audit; declassified index.
consequence_of_decision: Prevents diary entries from being over-used as substitutes for memcons, telcons, PDB content, or minutes.

decision: Can the printed State version of the July 12, 1990 Chief-of-Mission letter be used if no archival final copy is found?
recommended_default: Prefer signed/circulated White House, S/S, or all-post dissemination copy; use printed State text only as fallback after documented search.
evidence_already_assembled: Bush Chief-of-Mission letter report; Request D; source-note worklist.
consequence_of_decision: Determines whether the strongest field-management document can be selected from public text or must wait for archival copy.

decision: Should NSR-16 itself be selected, or should a response/options/follow-on decision paper supersede it?
recommended_default: Start with NSR-16, but select the follow-on decision record if it gives better management choices and source-note control.
evidence_already_assembled: NSR-16 review; Request C; selection worksheet.
consequence_of_decision: Determines the spine of the Function 150/budget chapter.

decision: Is NSC procedure an opening frame or a standalone chapter?
recommended_default: Use one strong opening document plus source-note support unless a procedural file shows a concrete management decision.
evidence_already_assembled: NSC administrative transition review; selection worksheet; declassified index.
consequence_of_decision: Prevents manuals and procedure binders from crowding out decision-bearing records.

decision: Should the March 25, 1992 NSC0062/NSR-29 packets stand in for unresolved NSR 29 and NSD 67 control copies?
recommended_default: Use the March 25 packets as public-control files for review/MDR, but keep pulling official NSR 29 and NSD 67 control copies.
evidence_already_assembled: Intelligence matters chapter; Requests B1/B2/B3; source-note worklist.
consequence_of_decision: Determines which intelligence-budget source note becomes the control citation.

decision: Is NSC/DC 151 selectable if the public packet remains mostly withdrawn?
recommended_default: Select only if minutes, summary, draft language, or substantive memoranda release enough decision content; otherwise use as MDR/source-note support.
evidence_already_assembled: NSC/DC 151 public PDF; Request A1; source-note worklist.
consequence_of_decision: Determines whether early covert-action/congressional consultation has a selected document or only an archival target.

decision: Are public budget speeches and Dispatch/Current Policy items selectable?
recommended_default: Use as fallback or editorial chronology; prefer internal OMB, State, White House, and lot-file records.
evidence_already_assembled: Current Policy sweep; Dispatch sweep; source-note audit.
consequence_of_decision: Keeps the volume centered on management decisions rather than public justification speeches.

decision: How many interagency case studies belong in the volume?
recommended_default: One or two maximum, only where the case reveals machinery, budget control, staffing, authority, or implementation disputes.
evidence_already_assembled: Selection worksheet; compiler gap assessment; cross-source candidates.
consequence_of_decision: Controls scope creep into regional policy substance.

decision: Should NIS assistance coordination become a late-volume management lane?
recommended_default: Develop it if Zoellick, Kanter, AID, S/P, or NSC economic files show implementation machinery rather than regional policy narrative.
evidence_already_assembled: Dispatch sweep; selection worksheet; Request F.
consequence_of_decision: Determines whether 1991-1992 coverage has a strong mature-administration management chapter.

decision: Which State lot files get first pull priority?
recommended_default: Start with Baker Lot 93D187, Eagleburger Lot 95D335, Kimmitt Lot 91D490, Zoellick Lot 94D589, Kanter Lot 93D396, and Ross Lot 93D519.
evidence_already_assembled: Research request packet Batch F; archival pull matrix; compiler gap assessment.
consequence_of_decision: Determines whether public speeches can be replaced by internal management records.

decision: What rule controls conflict between public text and archival original?
recommended_default: Archival control copy governs when available; public text remains locator, fallback, or editorial support.
evidence_already_assembled: Source-note audit; source-note worklist; link health audit.
consequence_of_decision: Prevents source notes from treating URLs, magazine text, FAS indexes, statutes, or Public Papers as final archival citations.
